The six labels above are inert, not links — The Light has no year-by-year web archive; each issue goes out by email as a PDF, so no single issue's link belongs on a public page. Weekly parish bulletins, which do have a public home, are posted at bulletinbuilder.org/ntgoc.

Contributing to The Light

Parish announcements, photographs and articles can be sent to newsletter@ntgoc.org. Please ask the people in a photograph before sending it, and ask a parent separately for any photograph that prominently features a child — the same rule the parish applies to photographs on the website.

The Light is published monthly. The copy deadline and who edits it are not recorded anywhere we could source — they belong on this page once someone confirms them.
